personas.name_zh: 盲人或低视力独立出行者
personas.need_zh: 不依赖屏幕识别方向、边界、变化和人工帮助。
personas.need_en: Recognize direction, edges, changes and human help without relying on a screen.
personas.risk_zh: 新触感与盲道混淆、临时标记磨损或被占用。
personas.risk_en: New textures may be confused with tactile paving, worn or obstructed.

personas.need_zh: 连续平顺净空、可预测礼让和不堵坡道的停靠。
personas.need_en: Continuous flush clearance, predictable yielding and berths that never block ramps.
personas.risk_zh: 触觉构件形成震动、绊阻、积水或转弯障碍。
personas.risk_en: Tactile elements may create vibration, obstruction, ponding or turning barriers.

personas.name_zh: 不使用智能手机的老年人
personas.need_zh: 可见的现场规则、稳定方向和可找到的人工渠道。
personas.need_en: Visible on-site rules, stable directions and findable human assistance.
personas.risk_zh: 规则过多、字太小、临时变化只在应用中通知。
personas.risk_en: Too many rules, small text or changes communicated only through an app.

personas.need_zh: 用少量词理解机器何时停、何处不可进入、怎样求助。
personas.need_en: Use a few words to know when robots stop, where not to enter and how to get help.
personas.risk_zh: 把符号当游戏、追逐机器人或误入停靠区。
personas.risk_en: Treating symbols as a game, chasing robots or entering berths.

personas.need_zh: 一眼判断人机优先关系和通行变化。
personas.need_en: Understand human-machine priority and route changes at a glance.
personas.risk_zh: 把概念标记误认成法定交通标线。
personas.risk_en: Mistaking a conceptual marker for a statutory traffic marking.

personas.need_zh: 快速发现磨损、污染、积雪、松动、过期版本和错误改道。
personas.need_en: Quickly detect wear, dirt, snow, looseness, expired versions and wrong detours.
personas.risk_zh: 责任不清或只修视觉层、不修触觉和机器层。
personas.risk_en: Unclear ownership or repairing the visual layer but not tactile and machine layers.

personas.need_zh: 明确泊位、等待位置、失败退出和不依赖个人信息的交接。
personas.need_en: Clear berth, waiting, failed-handover exit and an exchange without personal-data encoding.
personas.risk_zh: 为赶时效占用盲道、入口或无障碍坡道。
personas.risk_en: Blocking tactile paving, entrances or accessible ramps under delivery pressure.

personas.name_zh: 机器人开发与安全测试人员
personas.need_zh: 开放词典、可复现实验、版本记录、误读样本和明确停机条件。
personas.need_en: Open dictionary, reproducible tests, version history, misread samples and explicit stop conditions.
personas.risk_zh: 为通过测试针对单一铺装过拟合，或把高识别率误当安全证明。
personas.risk_en: Overfitting to one paving sample or treating high recognition as proof of safety.
